title: The voice in the tunnel
steps: {familiar} is inside the room. Voices come down the passage, and the three of you crouch to try to listen.
Someone undid your knots, Rinlo. I know who it was. Their name is {wizard}.
{familiar} shrinks with fear and hurries back through the passage, to your feet.
You have one thread left. Tie it to their wand. Their next spell will burst in their hands.
No. You said nobody would get hurt. The brooms were dangerous, and this could kill them.
No. Go away, get out of here.
You hear a few more noises. Then silence. The voice does not answer.
Rinlo? Listen! We heard you. We can help you: we know you stood up to it and told it no.
Come down with us, and we'll all go and talk to Orla so that she can help us.
I've broken it. I've torn all the thread to shreds… but it is still here, I can feel it, and it frightens me.
I can't come out there. Take the pieces, get them away from me. I don't even want to touch them.
{familiar} can bring them: perhaps that will calm Rinlo.
